title: Patient Financial Account — Virtual Visit Credit Hold Schedule
content:
| Virtual Care visit scheduled for the patient on the handling date | Amount of the Patient Financial Account credit kept |
|---|---|
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | 45.00 |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | 45.00 |
| another virtual visit type — Portal E-Visit, Audio-Only Phone Visit, Primary Care Video Visit or On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care — and neither of the two above | 25.00 |
| no virtual visit scheduled | nothing |

**Rule of the schedule.** Part of a credit on the Patient Financial Account is kept for a scheduled virtual visit: when a Specialty Video Follow-Up or a Behavioral Health Video Visit is scheduled, 45.00 is kept; when another virtual visit type is scheduled and neither of those is, 25.00 is kept; otherwise nothing is kept for a virtual visit. What is kept stays on the account as a credit and is not refunded.

**Notes to the schedule.**

1. "Scheduled" is the visit status on the patient's Virtual Care record; a completed or cancelled virtual visit is not scheduled.
2. The higher row governs when visits of both kinds are scheduled: a scheduled Primary Care Video Visit alongside a scheduled Behavioral Health Video Visit keeps 45.00, not 70.00.
3. One figure is kept for the account, not one per visit: two scheduled Specialty Video Follow-Ups keep 45.00.
4. Hypothetical: a patient with a credit of 120.00 and only an Audio-Only Phone Visit scheduled has 25.00 kept.
